speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Patients requiring urgent medical attention will be seen by the doctor, whilst non-urgent cases may be advised to seek treatment at a nearby general practitioner (GP) clinic.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) cardholders can receive subsidies for medical care at CHAS GP clinics.
